Site Discovery

anthropic.com — OF1 Demo Pipeline

Site Overview

Purpose Anthropic builds frontier AI systems (the Claude model family) with a safety-first mission, offering consumer apps, enterprise APIs, and vertical-specific solutions Product Lines Claude (AI assistant), Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Design, Claude Science, Claude Security; Models: Mythos, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku Audience Developers, enterprise teams, researchers, educators, government agencies, startups, individual professionals Tone Serious, mission-driven, academic yet accessible; emphasizes safety, responsibility, and long-term thinking with understated confidence

Proposed Demo

Focus: Claude AI Products

Showcasing the Claude product family and how personalized AI recommendations can guide visitors to the right product for their needs — from individual use to enterprise deployment.

Narrative

Persona: Sarah, VP of Engineering at a mid-size SaaS company

Journey: Sarah lands on Anthropic's homepage curious about safety-first AI. She discovers the product lineup and wants to understand which Claude offering best fits her team — from individual developer use (Claude Code) to team collaboration (Claude Cowork) to enterprise API deployment (Platform).

Why This Works

  • Anthropic has a rich product portfolio (6+ distinct products) ideal for personalized recommendations
  • The audience spans from individual developers to enterprise buyers — OF1 can tailor messaging per visitor intent
  • Multiple model tiers (Haiku to Mythos) create natural upsell/cross-sell opportunities
  • Industry-specific solutions (healthcare, finserv, government) enable persona-based personalization

Page Structure Analysis

Homepage

  • Hero: "AI research and products that put safety at the frontier" — mission statement with Try Claude CTA
  • Hard Questions: Philosophical framing about AI safety, governance, societal impacts
  • Latest Releases: Three announcement cards — Fable 5, Sonnet 5, Claude Science
  • Mission: "We build AI to serve humanity's long-term well-being"
  • Resources: Core Views on Safety, Responsible Scaling Policy, Anthropic Academy, Economic Index, Claude's Constitution

Research

  • Hero: Research heading with safety and societal impact intro
  • Team Filter: Alignment, Economic Research, Interpretability, Societal Impacts, Frontier Red Team
  • Featured Article: Large hero card — "A global workspace in language models"
  • Card Grid: 4 secondary research highlights
  • Publications: Searchable/filterable table with date, category, title
  • Recruitment CTA: "Join the Research team" banner

News

  • Press Block: Title, press email, support link, press kit download
  • Hero Feature: Large card — "Inviting hard questions"
  • Secondary Cards: Making of Claude Code, Fable 5, Sonnet 5, Claude Science
  • News Table: Searchable list — product launches, research, partnerships, policy
